skills.name: Brawler's Battlecry
skills.description: Poses and points at enemies. Good effects on allies.  *HP +330% (10 sec) *Recovers 100% of HP  *Move Speed +120% (10 sec)

skills.name: Swift Turbo Hooks
skills.description: Runs through swiftly while swinging at nearby enemies. Bad effects on enemies.  *ATK x 3400% Area Damage  *Enemy knockback  *Enemy ATK -50% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Tokyo Revengers 2
abilities.description: Tokyo Revengers 2 Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Same Fate 2
abilities.description: When the Ranger is defeated, it will randomly take 1 of the enemies with it. It has a high chance of activating in PVP and Guild War only, and will not activate in other battles. (Guardians will not be affected by this Ability)
